notes.title: Regional Price Adjustment Notice
notes.content:
This is a notice letting everyone know that the game's pricing will be adjusted in certain regions in early January 2023.

The primary reason for this change is the different economic situation compared to 7 years ago, when the game was released.

The base price for the game will remain at 0.99 U.S Dollars. The game will be using Steam's updated recommended pricing for other currencies.

If you have any questions or concerns, you can leave them in the comments below or send them to support@lastquarterstudios.com.

notes.title: Cats are Liquid - A Better Place is out now!
notes.content:
Cats are Liquid - A Better Place is a 2D platformer about a liquid cat and her friends.

You play as the cat, in a place created just for you and your friends. You get to go on a nice adventure with them where nothing goes wrong and everything is perfect, as long as your friends stay there, right by your side.

Over the course of the game, you get to explore 120 rooms and discover new abilities like the hookshot and light burst.

You can also create your own worlds, and share them with others through the Steam Workshop. All of the rooms in the game were made using the same editor that's included in the game. So if you see something in an official world, you can do that in your own custom world.

[b]There's a couple days left in the launch sale so if you're quick you can get it for just $1.35![/b]

Links!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1188080/Cats_are_Liquid__A_Better_Place/]Steam[/url], [url=https://lastquarterstudios.itch.io/cats-are-liquid-a-better-place]itch.io[/url], [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lastquarterstudios.catsareliquidabp]Google Play[/url], [url=https://apps.apple.com/app/cats-are-liquid-abp/id1485934366]App Store[/url]

notes.title: Last Quarter Studios Discord!
notes.content:
Hey! Listen!

There's a Last Quarter Studios Discord now!

discord.gg/Qa5sCd9

Discord is going to be a way better way to communicate plans regrading the next Cats are Liquid, progress updates and such. There’s channels for fan-art, story related discussions, announcements, all that cool stuff.

And (obviously) there’s also fancy custom emoji!

I’ll be (semi) active on there most of my waking hours, keeping the window open under/next to Unity and Visual Studio, and popping in to answer questions or to just chat.

There’s also a cool mod on there called Ninetales. He should be active around the time when I’m sleeping, so there’s always someone there to keep an eye on things.

There's about 50 members there already, and it's growing at a rather steady pace.

Go join before it’s too late! And by before it’s too late I mean before the invite link that I set to never expire, expires.

notes.title: Anniversary Update Plans
notes.content:
I looked at the calendar a couple weeks ago and noticed that it had been almost a year since Cats are Liquid first came out. I thought it would be a cool little idea to celebrate the anniversary of CaL with a small update. Nothing too amazing, just a couple random tweaks and extras. For example…
[list]
[*]Test levels made during development.
[*]Unused soundtracks.
[*]Random notes made during development.
[*]Cat blueprints.
[*]New sound effects for breaking dynamic objects. (Not quite sure about this one yet)
[*]Graphical updates. (see below)
[/list]
The graphical updates include denser lava fog, updated look for the magnets, extra glow particles on one-hit-kill surfaces, and the biggest change of all... The cat will be rendered using metaballs. No not meatballs. Metaballs. What are metaballs? [url=https://twitter.com/lquarterstudios/status/801497193165312000]This should explain it.[/url]

So, as I said, nothing too amazing. Just a couple small changes to make the game feel a bit more polished and some extras.

If everything goes as I've planned, the update will be released on December 7th.

notes.title: You can now get the soundtrack on Steam!
notes.content:
A quick update notifying you that you can now get the full soundtrack on Steam with no extra cost!

Previously you could only get the soundtrack on itch.io, but since I received multiple messages and emails saying that people would like to get the soundtrack on Steam, I decided to publish it here too.

Just update the game and the soundtrack should appear in your Steam music library.
